open_points.subject: canonical_bytes
open_points.text: MUST first, before json_text is parsed, raise NonCanonicalValueError with a reason naming the depth when json_depth of the UTF-8 bytes of json_text exceeds the imported RELEASE_CEILING_JSON_DEPTH_MAX constant
open_points.other_text: or when a string holds a lone surrogate.
open_points.question: Which requirement must change: calling json_depth first on UTF-8 bytes, or accepting that a lone surrogate has no UTF-8 encoding and must be rejected before those bytes can be produced?

open_points.subject: json_depth
open_points.text: MUST return the depth of the JSON text json_bytes holds — a scalar 0, an array or object one more than its deepest element or member value and 1 when it has none, a member's name adding no level — as the greatest nesting of opening brackets and braces outside strings
open_points.other_text: a string running from a double quote to the next double quote not escaped by a backslash;
open_points.question: How are these reconciled when a closing quote is preceded by an even-length run of backslashes, so the immediately preceding backslash is itself escaped and the quote ends the string?
